goal: Review a GraphQL schema and resolvers for query depth and cost limits, authorization per field, batching and…
use: Review a GraphQL schema and resolvers for query depth and cost limits, authorization per field, batching and error exposure. Use when a GraphQL API is added or changed.

steps.note: Read the schema. Open the schema, resolvers and any query limits.
Check depth and cost. Flag schemas with no depth or cost limit.
Check authorization per field. Authorization must hold at each field that returns private data, not only at the top query.
Check batching. Resolvers that call the database once per item cause the N+1 problem.
Check errors. Flag errors that return stack traces or internal fields to clients.
Report. List each finding with its type and field, severity and the fix.
